newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies nine muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies nine muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Thursday it qualified for bond insurance the following nine municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Bullhead City School District No 15, Ariz., $6.355 million school bonds.
--Paradise Valley Unified School District No 69, Ariz., $38.565 million school bonds.
--Santa Cruz County, Calif., $25.155 million refunding certificates of participation, by direct purchase.
--Pinelands Regional Board of Education, N.J., $9.025 million GOs.
--Wyckoff Township Board of Education, N.J., $3.6 million school bonds.
--Campbell-Savona Central School District, N.Y., $8 million GOs.
